reason: I'm not rewriting my old app this month, and if I ever do, whoever I pay to migrate it should be the one proving it works. Recording, sandboxing and confirming a list of business rules on my own machine is way more than an hour I don't have.
objection: I don't trust an AI to decide what counts as the same behavior. If it writes my business rules wrong and I just click confirm because I'm busy, I've got a green light on a broken app.
would_change_my_mind: My IT provider running it on the migration and handing me a one-page diff I can check in ten minutes, with the evidence for every difference.
